genes.name: row_layout
genes.hypothesis: Start from five horizontal rows (5,5,5,5,6 circles) instead of a centre circle plus two rings; the rows spread the centres evenly, whereas the outer ring is clipped onto the walls.
genes.author: llm:claude-fable-5-1

genes.name: neighbor_radii
genes.hypothesis: Set each starting radius to a fixed fraction of the distance to the nearest wall and nearest neighbour instead of scaling pairs down in turn; gives a uniform, strictly feasible start.
genes.author: llm:claude-fable-5-1

genes.name: slsqp_optimizer
genes.hypothesis: Optimise all centres and radii jointly with SLSQP under no-overlap and in-square constraints; moves the centres, which the initial program never does.
genes.author: llm:claude-fable-5-1

genes.name: refine_shrink
genes.hypothesis: Post-pass that shrinks overlapping pairs proportionally and caps radii at the wall distance (centres clipped to [0.001, 0.999]); removes the small violations a solver leaves.
genes.author: llm:claude-fable-5-1

genes.name: refine_expand
genes.hypothesis: Post-pass that grows each radius to nearly the largest value its neighbours and the walls allow; recovers slack left by margins and by the starting radii.
genes.author: llm:claude-fable-5-1

genes.name: ring_inner_radius
genes.hypothesis: Radius of the inner ring of 8 centres in the initial layout; unused once row_layout is on.
genes.author: llm:claude-fable-5-1

genes.name: ring_outer_radius
genes.hypothesis: Radius of the outer ring of 16 centres in the initial layout (0.7 leaves the square and is clipped); unused once row_layout is on.
genes.author: llm:claude-fable-5-1

genes.name: clip_margin
genes.hypothesis: Starting centres are clipped to [margin, 1 - margin]; same value in both programs.
genes.author: llm:claude-fable-5-1

genes.name: init_radius_fraction
genes.hypothesis: Fraction of the nearest wall / neighbour distance used as the starting radius; below 0.5 keeps the start feasible.
genes.author: llm:claude-fable-5-1

genes.name: slsqp_maxiter
genes.hypothesis: Iteration limit of SLSQP; more iterations let the optimiser get closer to a local optimum.
genes.author: llm:claude-fable-5-1

genes.name: slsqp_ftol
genes.hypothesis: Convergence tolerance of SLSQP on the objective.
genes.author: llm:claude-fable-5-1

genes.name: slsqp_overlap_margin
genes.hypothesis: Gap required between every pair of circles in the SLSQP constraint; costs score, buys feasibility.
genes.author: llm:claude-fable-5-1

genes.name: slsqp_wall_margin
genes.hypothesis: Gap required between every circle and the walls in the SLSQP constraint; costs score, buys feasibility.
genes.author: llm:claude-fable-5-1

genes.name: refine_pair_shrink
genes.hypothesis: An overlapping pair is shrunk so its radii sum to this factor times the centre distance.
genes.author: llm:claude-fable-5-1

genes.name: refine_wall_shrink
genes.hypothesis: Radii are capped at this factor times the distance to the nearest wall.
genes.author: llm:claude-fable-5-1

genes.name: refine_iterations
genes.hypothesis: Number of refinement sweeps (shared by refine_shrink and refine_expand); the expansion safety factor rises from 0.9996 to 0.9997 after sweep 3.
genes.author: llm:claude-fable-5-1

genes.name: refine_expand_factor
genes.hypothesis: Extra factor on the largest allowed radius in the expansion pass (multiplied with the 0.9996/0.9997 safety factor).
genes.author: llm:claude-fable-5-1
